author: Brandjuh
name: CrookHunt
short: Police-themed crook hunting for donut bounties.
description: Crooks spawn in configured channels; shout STOP POLICE or react 🚨 to cuff them for donuts. Salute the undercover officer! Escaped crooks pickpocket a random member into the donut pot (CrackPot cog). Police retheme of the classic hunting cog, ported from the Node CuffBot.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-member crook-catch statistics.
